title: Solutions and singularities of the Ricci-harmonic flow and Ricci-like flows of $\mathrm{G_2}$-structures
summary: We find explicit solutions and singularities of the Ricci-harmonic flow of $\mathrm{G_2}$-structures, the Ricci-like flows of $\mathrm{G_2}$-structures studied by Gianniotis-Zacharopoulos in arXiv:2505.06872 (J. Geom. Anal. 36.2 (2026)) and of the negative gradient flow of an energy functional of $\mathrm{G_2}$-structures, on $7$-dimensional contact Calabi-Yau manifolds and the $7$-dimensional Heisenberg group.
